title: Top food and drink tour
text: We had a great food tour with Elena, she gave us lots of information about Sevilla and places to visit in the city. Well worth the money with the amount of food and drinks included. Lasted just over 3hrs, which was just about right. Highly recommended.
author: wendyian

title: Great opportunity to try new food and drink
text: Really enjoyed this excursion, visiting bars and trying foods that we would not have experienced on our own. Great fun. Not just for younger tourists, most of our group were aged over 50 and there was a friendly atmosphere.
